name: carousel
label: Carousel
brief:
A swipeable post of 3 to 10 slides. Slide 1 decides whether people swipe, and fewer reach each later slide.
- Pick the shape that fits the idea: listicle (saves), myth-buster (shares), before/after (saves, follows), framework (saves).
- Cover: a promise with an open loop ("most people get #3 wrong"), a number when it fits.
- Strongest point on slide 2 or 3. One point per slide, each standing alone. Choose the slide type that fits each point: a figure is a number slide, an order is steps, a wrong belief is a myth, two options are a compare, one action is a tip. Vary the types.
- Aim for 5 to 8 slides: develop the idea, never pad it.
- Closing: a recap worth saving on its own, plus one ask (save it, or send it to someone).
- Caption: one short paragraph, no call to action (the closing slide has it).

slides.title: Promise with an open loop, max 8 words
slides.subtitle: One line that sharpens the promise

slides.value: The figure with its unit, max 8 characters
slides.caption: What it measures, one line

slides.title: What the steps achieve, max 8 words

slides.myth: The wrong belief, as people say it

format.caption: Hook in the first 125 characters, then a line or two of context. No hashtags

slides.title: Fill a moka pot the right way
slides.subtitle: Four small moves that change your morning coffee.

slides.myth: You should tamp the coffee down hard.
slides.fact: Not in a moka pot: just level it. Packed coffee makes it hard for water to pass, and the result tastes bitter and burnt.

steps.title: Water
steps.text: In the bottom chamber, just below the valve.

steps.title: Coffee
steps.text: In the filter basket, no tamping.

steps.title: Level
steps.text: Wipe stray grounds off the rim.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Screw it shut firmly, without forcing it.

slides.title: Why the valve matters
slides.body: It releases pressure if something gets blocked. If the water covers it, it can't do its job.

slides.caption: Roughly the pressure inside a moka pot.
slides.body: Espresso uses around 9: that's why they're two different coffees.

slides.note: Never let the flame reach past the sides of the base.

slides.title: Save it for tomorrow morning
slides.body: Four moves, no extra gear. The moka does the rest.

sample_content.caption: Your moka coffee tastes burnt? It might be how you fill it. Four small moves, in order, and the one habit to drop.
